standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 1403-1410: the data C_n, f_phi, u_phi, D, a_0, C'_n, f'_phi, u'_phi, D', a'_0 and morphisms h_n, n >= -1, as in the remark.

standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 1419-1420: the morphism h (with component h_n) is defined by this lemma.

standard_prerequisites.name: The augmentation topos morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 1420-1423: the morphisms a and a' are defined by this lemma; the only remaining content is the commutativity of the diagram.

standard_prerequisites.name: The componentwise description of the total topoi
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 1425-1430: by the component diagrams of the morphism lemma and the componentwise description of the total topoi, it suffices that the component squares commute for all n.

core_obligations: Reduction (proof lines 1419-1430): h comes from the morphism-of-simplicial-sites lemma and a, a' from the augmentation lemma; proving a^{-1} h_{-1}^{-1} = h_{total}^{-1} (a')^{-1}, the componentwise description reduces the commutativity of the total square to commutativity of the component squares Sh(C_n) -> Sh(C'_n) over Sh(D), Sh(D') for all n.

The component squares (lines 1430-1447): the case n = 0 is an assumption in the remark; for n > 0 pick phi : [0] -> [n], and the required commutativity follows from the case n = 0 together with the relations a_n = a_0 f_phi and a'_n = a'_0 f'_phi and the commutation relations f'_phi h_n = h_0 f_phi.
proof_roadmap: Obtain h, a, a' from the two established topos-morphism lemmas.
Reduce the commutativity of the total square to the component squares.
Settle n = 0 by the remark's assumption and propagate to n > 0 via the simplicial relations.

H2: infrastructure commutativity assembled from established morphisms.
